mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend (user_id, friend_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{friendId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM friend WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND friend_id = #{friendId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id as userId, u.nickname as nickname, u.level as level, u.exp as exp, u.solved_count as solvedCount, false as isRival -- Default for now, requires Rival logic FROM friend f JOIN user u ON f.friend_id = u.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId}
